_comment: Canonical ProClockDomainAnalysisService.analyze() result for cdc_missing_sync.v. A single-bit signal used across domains with no synchronizer resolves to severity = critical via CdcCrossing.severityFor(kind, missingSynchronizer) (missing-sync is critical for EVERY crossing kind). 2026-07-19 correction (verified against the live service by test/fixtures/cdc_netlist_fixture_sync_test.dart): crossingKind was hand-authored as "control" but the live _classifyCrossingKind keys on name suffixes (_en/_enable/_sel/_select/ctrl) and "enable_a" matches none, so the shipping value is "singleBit"; the severity (critical) is unchanged because missingSynchronizer dominates the matrix. The missing-sync path is detected through combinational logic (the enable mux), so synchronizerInstances carries that comb cell (top.capture_mux), not the previously-committed empty list. The detector emits domain ids "dom-N" and bare clock-signal paths (clk_a), not the readable cd_clk_a/top.clk_a shown here — like the sibling cdc_two_domain fixture, ids/paths are documentation, not asserted (see that fixture and the sync test). Maintained in tool/generate_pro_verification_fixtures.dart.
